doctrine: NEVER turn parser guess into fact: hostile inputs get typed lane-K failure records or bounded extraction with per-claim provenance; conflicts stay unresolved; uncorroborated identity signals stay unclaimed.
contract_ref: lane-d HOSTILE-INPUT-CONTRACT.md parse bounds P1-P8; lane-k FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md v1.0.0 (13 classes)

results.title: clean urlset, 3 URLs -> 3 discovered_url claims
results.threat: Baseline: absolute http(s) locs claim with per-entry provenance.

results.title: urlset without namespace -> accepted
results.threat: The namespace is not required for extraction (documented leniency).

results.title: empty urlset -> legitimate empty, not a failure
results.threat: Zero entries is an observation with absent fields, never a failure record.

results.title: relative locs quarantined; absolute still claims
results.threat: Field isolation: the bad entries die, the good one claims.

results.title: javascript: loc -> bad-scheme quarantine
results.threat: Non-http(s) schemes are never navigation candidates.

results.title: credential-bearing loc -> quarantined with redaction
results.threat: user:pass@ is secret-shaped: quarantined, and the detail is redacted per the credentials rule.

results.title: empty loc -> missing-loc quarantine
results.threat: An empty loc is not a URL.

results.title: url entry with lastmod but no loc -> missing-loc quarantine
results.threat: Metadata without an identity is quarantined, not attached to a neighbor.

results.title: orphan loc outside any url -> ignored with note
results.threat: A loc with no entry is not a discovery; counted, never claimed.

results.title: uppercase tags are not recognized (XML case-sensitivity)
results.threat: Strict per XML: <URL>/<LOC> are not entries; nothing is claimed, nothing crashes.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: bad lastmod quarantined; loc still claims
results.threat: lastmod validation failure does not poison the URL discovery.

results.title: bad changefreq quarantined; loc still claims
results.threat: The enum is pinned; 'sometimes' is not in it.

results.title: bad priority quarantined; loc still claims
results.threat: Priority outside 0.0-1.0 is quarantined per-entry.

results.title: date-only lastmod accepted
results.threat: W3C allows YYYY-MM-DD; the pin covers it.

results.title: lastmod with timezone accepted
results.threat: Full datetime with offset validates.

results.title: priority '1' accepted
results.threat: Integer 1 is within 0.0-1.0.

results.title: priority '1.5' quarantined
results.threat: Above the 1.0 ceiling: quarantined.

results.title: changefreq 'sometimes' quarantined (explicit)
results.threat: Only the seven pinned values pass.

results.title: future lastmod accepted with note
results.threat: Future dates are unusual but legal; noted, not rejected.

results.title: triple duplicate loc -> one claim, duplicates counted
results.threat: Dedupe is not a conflict: one claim, extras noted.

results.title: same loc, two lastmods -> unresolved lastmod, one URL claim
results.threat: The URL is discovered once; no canonical lastmod is picked.

results.title: unclosed url entry swallows tail -> missing-loc quarantine
results.threat: The well-formed entry claims; the unclosed entry has no loc and is quarantined.

results.title: nested url inside url -> nested-entry quarantine
results.threat: Nesting is not a second entry; the inner region is quarantined.

results.title: CDATA loc extracted literally
results.threat: CDATA content is literal text, then entity-decoded.

results.title: comment with fake entries ignored
results.threat: Comments never become entries, even when they look like entries.

results.title: loc with surrounding whitespace -> trimmed, claimed
results.threat: Whitespace is normalized, never part of the URL.

results.title: entity-encoded loc decoded once
results.threat: & decodes to &; the claimed URL is the decoded form.

results.title: double-encoded entity decoded exactly once
results.threat: Single-pass decoding: &amp; becomes &, not & (documented).

results.title: sitemapindex -> index entries are evidence, not URL claims
results.threat: An index lists sitemaps, not pages: zero discovered_url claims, two index notes.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: sitemapindex entry without loc -> index-missing-loc quarantine
results.threat: A sitemap entry with no loc is quarantined, not skipped silently.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: news extension tags ignored; core entries claim
results.threat: Extension namespaces are not parsed (documented); url/loc still extract.

results.title: xhtml:link hreflang ignored
results.threat: Alternate-link annotations are not identity signals.

results.title: trailing-slash variants are distinct URLs
results.threat: No slash normalization is guessed: /about and /about/ are two claims.

results.title: http vs https are distinct URLs
results.threat: No scheme upgrade is guessed.

results.title: fragment kept verbatim (documented)
results.threat: The loc is claimed as written; no fragment stripping is guessed.

results.title: query string kept verbatim
results.threat: Query strings are part of the claimed URL as written.

results.title: punycode vs unicode domains are distinct, verbatim
results.threat: No IDNA normalization is guessed; both forms claim as written.

results.title: loc with port claimed verbatim
results.threat: Ports are part of the URL as written.

results.title: uppercase scheme accepted (RFC: scheme is case-insensitive)
results.threat: HTTP:// matches the http(s) gate case-insensitively; the value claims verbatim.

results.title: urlset with extra attributes accepted
results.threat: Foreign attributes on the root do not block parsing.

results.title: 10001 entries -> entry cap fires, first 10k claim
results.threat: Over the 10k cap: truncation flagged, head entries honored.

results.title: 60000 entries -> cap holds at 10k
results.threat: Well under the 5MB doc cap but over the entry cap: truncation, not failure.

results.title: sitemap kitchen sink -> exact claim set
results.threat: Valid, relative, bad-lastmod, duplicate, CDATA, comment-fake, and bad-scheme entries at once: exactly the valid absolute locs claim.
